spec.description: A list of all nodes in the cluster along with their spec. This table helps to get a quick idea about the resources in the cluster.
spec.title: Cluster Node

spec.expr:
{job="system_journal", instance=~"$node", cluster="$cluster"}
  | line_format `{{if eq .level "err"}}❌{{else if eq .level "crit"}}🛑{{else if eq .level "warning"}}⚠️{{else}}ℹ️{{end}} [{{.level}}] 🖥️ {{.instance}} | 📦 {{.unit}} ({{.transport}}) ➡️ {{ __line__ }}`
